segments.name: Banking services
segments.description: Provides banking services to individuals and companies primarily in New Jersey and New York, including commercial, residential and consumer lending and deposits.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single reportable segment under ASC 280, as the Chief Operating Decision Maker (CODM) reviews financial performance and allocates resources based on the consolidated results of the Company as a whole.

revenueModel.text: Earns net interest income from interest on loans and investment securities, net of interest paid on deposits and borrowings.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's primary measure of profitability is net interest income, which represents interest earned on loans and investment securities, net of interest expense on deposits and borrowings.
